Amazon::10570295.experience_required: Prior experience in program/project management, cross-functional delivery, data-led process improvement and supply chain; no numeric minimum stated.

Amazon::10570295.decision_scope_and_ownership: Own outbound network planning for a UK sub-region covering 3–5 sort centers; optimize flows, cost and speed from forecasts/data and coordinate network changes and Peak transformations.
Amazon::10570295.seniority_evidence: No years are stated and no direct reports are required, but the role requires several prior functional experiences and owns regional network-planning decisions.
Amazon::10570295.rationale: Strong operations/planning, analytics and cross-functional fit at a priority employer, but the JD makes supply-chain experience plus SQL core requirements. At Luxembourg’s 80 threshold the profile is close but not strong enough to mark reportable.
